text:
Asking rents in Gelsenkirchen stand at a median of 7.56 €/m² (2026-06), up 3.4% on the year and +23.5% over five years. That ranks Gelsenkirchen #36 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 38% above the 2022 average contract rent of 5.47 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 454 € a month in cold rent, 13.5% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 41 days and 16% are gone within a week; with 3.4% market-active vacancy and +1.5% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 8.02 €/m² (+6.1%), with an 80% range of 7.78 to 8.17 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
